11  
  
GLIC007 Hyaluronic acid agents Guideline  
APPLICABLE AGENT(S):   
Preferred  
Non-Preferred*  
Euflexxa  
Durolane, Gel-One, Genvisc 850, 
Hyalgan, Hymovs, Monovis, Orthovisc, 
Supartz, Supartz FX, Synojoynt, Triluron, 
TriVisc, Visco-3, Synvisc   
   
CRITERIA FOR AUTHORIZATION:   
New Start  
1. Member at least 18 years of age with a diagnosis of moderate to severe 
(grade III or higher) osteoarthritis confirmed by radiology. Note: Moderate 
joint space reduction is consistent with grade 3 osteoarthritis. Mild to 
moderate (grade I-II) not covered.  AND   
2. There is medical record documentation that the member has previously 
trialed and failed to adequately respond to non-pharmacologic therapy 
(exercise, physical therapy, weight loss, braces, local heat and cold 
application) for a minimum of 6 weeks  AND   
3. There is medical record documentation that the member has trialed and 
failed to adequately respond to simple analgesics (acetaminophen, topical 
capsaicin, oral or topical NSAIDs) for a minimum of 6 weeks  AND   
4. Member received at least one prior intra-articular corticosteroid injection or 
has a contraindication to corticosteroids   
5. Member does not have a history of total knee arthroplasty for the requested 
knee 
 
Renewal/Continuation of therapy  
1. Member at least 18 years of age with a diagnosis of moderate to severe 
(grade III or higher) osteoarthritis confirmed by radiology and previously 
been treated for the same knee with any hyaluronic 
acid/viscosupplementation product. Note: Moderate joint space reduction is 
consistent with grade 3 osteoarthritis. Mild to moderate (grade I-II) not 
covered.   AND   
2. It has been at least 6 months since the last treatment with this agent  AND   
3. Medical record documentation supports that the patient experienced a 
significant improvement in knee pain and functional capacity from the last 
series of injections  AND   
4. Medical record documentation supports that the patient experienced 
improved pain and functional capacity for at least 6 months (including no 
intraarticular corticosteroids administered for at least 6 months) AND 
5. Member does not have a history of total knee arthroplasty for the requested 
knee 
 
LENGTH OF AUTHORIZATION:   
Initial Approval Duration: 3 months   


=== PDF PAGE 12 ===
12  
  
Renewal Approval Duration: 1 year     
 
*Non-preferred agents will not be approved for coverage because the plan's 
preferred product is Euflexxa. Patients must use the preferred hyaluronic 
acid/viscosupplementation product.
